$comment: MTEC-15/B07 reconciliation matrix. OBSERVED columns were read from ms-users@20898978d7f49c38e21b49187250bdd1821c370f and MarketTec@afb423bb73e43fd033f67dbc354728960e8a071c. PROPOSED columns are recommendations, not approvals. Nothing here marks B07 approved, records a team conformity or authorizes a behavior change.

javaState.gated: Route exists in Java but is registered only when its feature flags and verified-topology settings are on (all default off).
javaState.gated-refuses: Route exists behind flags and refuses in every configuration of the current code (only session/activity).
javaState.always-on: Registered without feature flag (still profile-bound to sql-*).

kind.doc-only: Fix documentation/OpenAPI text or fixtures; no runtime change.
kind.behavior: Changes Java or Angular runtime behavior; needs the named decision before coding.
kind.needs-authorization: Touches a security decision reserved to the responsible owner.

priority.P0: Blocks the coordinated core increment (Google to logout).
priority.P1: Needed for the core increment to behave correctly in the browser.

legend.editorialNote: kind and priority are editorial triage labels. They are not an exhaustive security-impact classification and do not replace a security review.
legend.evidence: Java columns come from static inspection of the controllers, not from an integrated HTTP run.

operations.requestJava: none
{method:'google', purpose?:'login'|'register'}; unknown fields rejected; Origin allow-listed; X-MTEC-Client: web; purpose omitted defaults to login
operations.requestOpenapi: {method, purpose} both required; method enum AuthMethod; register only with google
operations.responseJava: 200 {attemptId(32 lowercase hex), method, purpose, expiresAt, csrfToken, nonce}; Set-Cookie __Host-mtec-attempt HttpOnly Secure Path=/ SameSite=Lax Max-Age=300
operations.responseOpenapi: 200 AttemptResponse; purpose enum also lists reauthenticate/link; nonce optional; SameSite pending B06
operations.angular: absent: login.ts uses one GIS callback; no attempt, no nonce

divergences.summary: Java accepts a missing purpose (defaults to login); OpenAPI requires it. Angular must always send purpose; tightening Java is a behavior change.
attemptId is documented as opaque (max 128); Java emits and accepts only 32 lowercase hex. Narrower acceptance is compatible for clients that echo the issued value.
SameSite=Lax and Path=/ are hard-coded in Java but SameSite/hosts are still pending B06 and no real hosts are verified. Implemented, not approved.
purpose=register answers 503 AUTH_TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE unless users.google.registration.enabled=true (default false). Angular must treat it as 'registration unavailable', not as a login failure.
Missing or wrong X-MTEC-Client gives 400 INVALID_REQUEST here but 403 FORBIDDEN on session/refresh/logout. Pick one mapping.

operations.requestJava: {attemptId(32 hex), credential(<=16384 chars)}; cookie __Host-mtec-attempt (64 hex) + X-CSRF-Token = sha256('mtec-attempt-csrf:'+secret); a register attempt is routed to the registration service when registration is enabled
operations.responseJava: 200 AuthResponse {token, tokenType:'Bearer', expiresAt, user{userId,email,nombre,fotoPerfil}, session{11 fields}, csrfToken}; Set-Cookie attempt cleared, __Host-mtec-refresh set (Max-Age = seconds to session deadline)
operations.responseOpenapi: 200 AuthResponse (same shape); fotoPerfil optional in OpenAPI, always emitted by Java
operations.angular: absent: GoogleAuthService.signIn stores the Google credential as the session token

divergences.summary: A login with an unknown Google identity returns 401 AUTH_PROOF_INVALID. OpenAPI documents REGISTRATION_REQUIRED, which Java never emits, so Angular cannot tell 'not registered' from 'bad proof'.

The 2026-11-04 DECISION_LOG entry approves immediate Google registration with 200 AuthResponse. The older mandatory-link proposal is superseded. Java registers immediately only when users.google.registration.enabled=true and the attempt was created with purpose=register.
Java sets WWW-Authenticate: Bearer on every 401 of this route, including cookie/proof failures. Document it so Angular does not read it as 'send a bearer'.
429 RATE_LIMITED is documented but never emitted by Java. Rate limiting is expected at APIM (apim abuse_protection approval is null).

operations.requestJava: same body and proofs as /v1/auth/google
operations.responseJava: 200 AuthResponse; 503 AUTH_TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE when registration is disabled

divergences.summary: Alias kept for migration. Angular should call /v1/auth/google with a register attempt and not depend on the alias.

operations.requestJava: Origin required (single, allow-listed); X-MTEC-Client: web; refresh cookie (64 hex); request must be secure
operations.requestOpenapi: Origin optional for some same-origin GET; X-MTEC-Client; refresh cookie
operations.responseJava: 200 SessionResponse {session, user, csrfToken}; no JWT, no rotation
operations.angular: absent: authGuard.restoreSession decodes a Google token from sessionStorage

divergences.summary: Java requires Origin on this GET; OpenAPI says GET may omit it. A cross-origin fetch always sends Origin, so Angular is unaffected, but the contract text and Java disagree.
APIM manifest marks the refresh cookie 'optional' for this route; Java rejects a missing cookie with 401 REFRESH_INVALID. APIM must treat the cookie as required.
csrfToken returned here is the synchronizer for the current refresh generation. Another tab that rotated first invalidates a stale CSRF held by this tab. Tab protocol is not approved.

operations.requestJava: body exactly {mode:'rotate'}; refresh cookie (64 hex) + X-CSRF-Token (64 hex); Origin; X-MTEC-Client: web
operations.responseJava: 200 AuthResponse; new refresh cookie; mode=continue answers 400 INVALID_REQUEST

divergences.summary: Policy C is implemented: a consumed, invalid or mismatched proof yields 401 REFRESH_INVALID and a replay alone does not revoke the winner. Keep it. Missing or malformed CSRF also yields 401 REFRESH_INVALID, not 403 CSRF_INVALID.
mode=continue is documented but not implemented (400). Angular must not call it.
Two tabs and lost responses: a loser tab holding a stale CSRF gets REFRESH_INVALID, which must not close the winner's session. Protocol is a recommendation only.

operations.requestJava: body exactly {scope:'current'}; Origin; single X-MTEC-Client: web; CSRF header required only when the refresh cookie is present
operations.responseJava: 204 and refresh cookie cleared (Max-Age=0), including when the cookie was absent; scope=all answers 400

divergences.summary: A 204 proves revocation in ms-users only. Already-issued access JWTs stay valid up to their exp (<=240 s nominal; residual <=300 s is documented, not demonstrated). Angular UI must not promise instant global logout.
scope=all is not implemented (400) and depends on B04.

operations.angular: profile/user.service.ts calls /usuarios/{id}; profile.ts falls back to the hard-coded id USR-001

divergences.summary: Missing, expired or malformed access token answers 401 AUTH_REQUIRED. AUTH_REQUIRED is not in the OpenAPI error-code enum, and ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRED is never emitted, so expiry cannot be distinguished server-side.
Java also emits USER_NOT_FOUND, USER_DEACTIVATED, CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION, INTERNAL_ERROR, ROUTE_NOT_FOUND and METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED; none is in the OpenAPI enum.

operations.securityNote: OpenAPI Draft declares bearerAuth AND apimSubscriptionKey inside ONE security requirement object, i.e. both are required (not alternatives). Java observed: requires only the internal JWT and never reads Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key. Proposed target (not approved): SPA with no confidential subscription key, subject to MTEC-41 and validation on a real APIM.

angularDivergences.summary: Google ID Token stored as the session token and sent as bearer to every API call.
Google sub used as user id; 'USR-001' hard-coded in profile.ts:25 and my-publications.ts:29.
sessionStorage key google_token (auth-token.service.ts) holds the credential; the approved profile forbids web storage for access/CSRF.
ApiClientService sets no withCredentials; refresh and attempt cookies are never sent.
No refresh, no 401 retry guard, no tab coordination, no logout call.
Single GIS callback; no separate login and register actions and no nonce.
Error handling reads error.message; the envelope is error.error.error.message with a code that is never mapped.
Request paths omit the /v1 prefix (/usuarios/{id}); APIM manifest also uses public paths without /v1. The mapping is not verified against a real APIM.
login.service.ts still models a password form for institutional email; unrelated to the Google core.

AT-ATTEMPT-1.description: A login attempt returns 200 AttemptResponse and sets __Host-mtec-attempt HttpOnly Secure Path=/ without Domain.

AT-ATTEMPT-2.description: Observed: omitted purpose is accepted as login. Proposed: purpose is required (D-09).

AT-ATTEMPT-3.description: purpose=register with registration disabled returns 503 AUTH_TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE.

AT-GOOGLE-1.description: A valid exchange returns AuthResponse with session.serverTime < expiresAt <= session.expiresAt and expiresAt - serverTime <= 240.

AT-GOOGLE-2.description: Wrong CSRF gives 403 CSRF_INVALID; disallowed or missing Origin gives 403 ORIGIN_DENIED.

AT-GOOGLE-3.description: Registration with the flag on returns the same AuthResponse; a consumed attempt gives 409 ATTEMPT_CONSUMED and an expired one 410 ATTEMPT_EXPIRED.

AT-GOOGLE-4.description: Observed: unknown identity at login gives 401 AUTH_PROOF_INVALID. Proposed (D-06): REGISTRATION_REQUIRED after a valid proof.

AT-SESSION-1.description: GET /v1/auth/session returns SessionResponse with no token and no Set-Cookie rotation.

AT-SESSION-2.description: Missing or malformed refresh cookie gives 401 REFRESH_INVALID.

AT-REFRESH-1.description: mode=rotate returns AuthResponse and a new refresh cookie.

AT-REFRESH-2.description: A consumed, invalid or mismatched proof gives 401 REFRESH_INVALID with no JWT, no CSRF and no Set-Cookie (policy C).

AT-REFRESH-4.description: A replay does not revoke the winning generation (policy C).

AT-LOGOUT-1.description: scope=current gives 204 and clears the cookie, including with no cookie.

AT-PROFILE-1.description: GET /v1/me/profile returns UserProfileV1 for the token subject.

AT-PROFILE-2.description: Missing, expired or malformed bearer gives 401 (code AUTH_REQUIRED today).

AT-PROFILE-3.description: PUT /v1/me/profile accepts exactly the three fields and returns UpdateUserResponseV1.

AT-PROFILE-4.description: /v1/usuarios/{userId} with an id different from sub gives 403 FORBIDDEN.

AT-JWKS-1.description: JWKS is public, carries only public RSA keys and unique kid.

AT-EMAIL-OFF-1.description: With users.email.enabled=false both email routes answer 503 AUTH_TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE.

AT-BLOCKED-1.description: POST /v1/auth/session/activity answers 403 ACTIVITY_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED and changes no deadline.

AT-BLOCKED-2.description: Proof and method-linking routes stay unavailable or unchanged while B04 is open.

AT-ANGULAR-USERID-1.description: Angular never sends Google sub or USR-001 as a user id; the id comes from AuthResponse.user.userId.
